city_center.name: Second Street Market — Dayton's historic public market (1830s)
city_center.landmark: Second Street Market (Dayton), public market hall; Miami Valley farmland to the south (Lebanon orchard belt)
city_center.notes: Second Street Market is Dayton's historic public market, open year-round in a restored freight depot. The Lebanon orchard belt (Warren County) south supplies tomatoes (late harvest Sep), apples Oct, pumpkins Oct-Nov. sources: Dayton Second Street Market.
